title: Smoothness of Gaussian noise
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in(-1,1)$, and let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ be integrable with respect to standard Gaussian measure $\gamma_n$ on $\mathbb R^n$. The Gaussian noise function $x\mapsto T_\rho f(x)$ is infinitely continuously differentiable on $\mathbb R^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ is integrable with respect to $\gamma_n$
